title: Microsoft Fabric IQ: A Deep Dive
summary: A community/blog roundup of Fabric IQ as it stood after Microsoft Build 2026, mostly restating Microsoft Learn concepts but adding a same-page inventory of which IQ-family items reached GA at Build 2026 (Operations agent, Graph in Fabric, Planning) versus which stayed in preview (Ontology), plus a list of the June 2026 wave of Fabric Data Agent feature previews and where Fabric IQ shows up across the wider Microsoft agent ecosystem.
audience: Readers tracking the Fabric IQ/data-agent roadmap who want a single post cross-referencing Build 2026 release status across the IQ family, rather than reading each Microsoft Learn page separately.
why_it_matters: The knowledge base's existing fabric-iq and fabric-data-agent sources are Microsoft Learn conceptual/how-to pages without firm release-status dates; this post is useful chiefly for the specific, checkable GA/preview milestones and the June 2026 data-agent feature-preview names it attributes to Microsoft's own Build 2026 announcements, which point to primary sources worth ingesting directly.
takeaways: As of Build 2026 (per the post), several IQ-family items moved to general availability together — Operations agent, Graph in Fabric, and Planning in Fabric — while the Ontology item itself remained in preview.

The post attributes a named wave of Fabric Data Agent preview features to the June 2026 Fabric update cycle: service principal authentication, a faster NL2SQL runtime, a Python code-interpreter step, an AI-assisted 'Creator Agent' setup flow, and Foundry-based observability.

Fabric IQ is described as reachable through multiple Microsoft surfaces beyond the Fabric portal itself — Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Agent 365, and GitHub Copilot CLI — positioning it as a shared backend rather than a single-app feature.

The post frames Operations agents and Data agents as reactive-vs-proactive counterparts: Data agent answers on-demand questions, Operations agent continuously monitors and can trigger governed actions via Fabric Activator.

claims.text: Per the post, at Microsoft Build 2026 the Operations agent, Graph in Fabric, and Planning in Fabric items reached general availability while the Ontology item remained in preview.
Per the post, a June 2026 Fabric update introduced a preview service-principal authentication option for data agents, letting automated callers authenticate without an interactive user sign-in.
Per the post, a preview NL2SQL runtime update in June 2026 was described as improving query-generation accuracy by roughly 20% in Microsoft's own internal benchmarks.
Per the post, a preview Code Interpreter capability lets a data agent execute Python for tasks like forecasting or statistical analysis in addition to generating SQL/DAX/KQL queries.
Per the post, a preview 'Creator Agent' feature assists a human builder by AI-generating initial configuration for SQL and Eventhouse data sources when setting up a data agent.
Per the post, a preview observability integration with Microsoft Foundry adds per-request tracing and latency monitoring for data agent calls.

The post positions Fabric IQ as reachable from multiple first-party Microsoft surfaces beyond the Fabric portal, including Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio (as an MCP tool in preview), Microsoft Agent 365, and GitHub Copilot CLI.

The post describes an Operations agent and a Data agent as complementary rather than overlapping: the Data agent is reactive and conversational, while the Operations agent continuously monitors data and can autonomously trigger governed actions.
